spec.scope: Synthetic shared-map bot-vs-bot games; actual Bot commands, equal seeded waves, seat swaps and carried damage; no official win-rate claim.

assumptions.initialState: 75 gold, station HP 1500, 2 workers HP 220 and pioneer HP 200; no prebuilt towers or walls; newly built towers are level 1
assumptions.waves: lab/arena.py defines increasing moderate/heavy waves; these counts and central spawn locations are synthetic; day-indexed RNG is independent of policy-dependent mining
assumptions.targetTeam: Each robot targets the camp declared by targetTeam, confirmed by the user and upstream interface
assumptions.robotBehavior: One-cell greedy steps, seeded movement ties; attacks nearest own-target-camp unit or prioritizes that camp's base within range 3; exact official behavior remains unknown; advance stress profile ignores reachable side targets while a move toward the base exists, then attacks the base through walls at range 3; this is an unverified conservative sensitivity case
assumptions.weapons: Rocket center 20 and eight-neighbor splash 10; period 4; gatling nearest ray intersection 10 per bullet; railgun energy 10 per level; ray-cell boundary handling is unverified
assumptions.settlement: Weapon hits use start-of-turn positions; robot movement follows; damage settles at turn end; lethally hit robots still act
assumptions.movement: Start-occupied cells stay blocked, same-destination moves cancel, vacated-cell chains unsupported
assumptions.construction: Tower ring at distance 1 from base footprint, wall ring at distance 2, matching current Demo implementation; zones are inferred from the rule illustration
assumptions.mining: Three initial stone mines per camp, ten collections each, seeded relocation outside building rings; no ore sale or shop system
assumptions.continuity: Base/tower/wall HP and remaining gold carry across nights; dead roles revive after 20 next-day turns; no automatic building heal or free towers; old robots clear at dawn
assumptions.omitted: Official tasks/news/treasure, trading/upgrades, summons, direct player attacks, official spawn/judge engine; opponent-only robots attacking foreign blockers is not modelled
